{{Top|leg}}
The '''8932/D Sensor Pack''' was a [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]] made by the [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]]. It had a range of 300 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and could be used to detect life forms and communications signals.
